exposure: mode of conception (spontaneous vs. assisted reproduction)
outcome: chorionicity complications (twin-twin transfusion syndrome, selective fetal growth restriction, twin anemia-polycythemia sequence)
cohort: 393 women with monochorionic twin pregnancies who delivered at a tertiary referral University center between January 2010 to December 2019
finding: Monochorionic twins conceived through assisted reproduction had a significantly higher risk of congenital heart defects compared to those spontaneously conceived.
gest_age: 34 weeks for ART pregnancies, 35 weeks for spontaneously conceived pregnancies (not statistically significant)
birth_weight: 1951 g +/- 747 in ART pregnancies vs 2143 g +/- 579 in spontaneously conceived pregnancies (not statistically significant)
